NODE_ENV.about: `production` makes `DATABASE_URL` or `MONGODB_URI` and `SESSION_SECRET` required, and session cookies secure

HOST.about: The address the server listens on. `0.0.0.0` in a container

PORT.about: The port the server listens on

LOG_LEVEL.about: How much the log says: `fatal`, `error`, `warn`, `info`, `debug`, `trace` or `silent`. A line never holds a query string, a token or a visitor's address

DASHBOARD_DIR.about: The built dashboard to serve. The image sets it

MONGODB_URI.about: Runs the server on MongoDB. Set this or `DATABASE_URL`, never both

DATABASE_URL.about: A `postgres://` or `postgresql://` URL: runs the server on PostgreSQL

DATABASE_POOL_SIZE.about: Connections to PostgreSQL this process may hold, 1 to 200

DATABASE_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS.about: How long one PostgreSQL statement may run before the server cancels it

REDIS_URL.about: Who is online now, the realtime nudge and the record of used single sign-on tokens kept in Redis rather than in this process. Needed when more than one process runs

TRUST_PROXY.about: Comma separated address ranges allowed to say who a visitor is

REAL_IP_HEADER.about: Or `CF-Connecting-IP`, believed only from a trusted range, or `X-Chokh-Forwarded-For`, believed only when signed with `CHOKH_PROXY_SECRET`

CHOKH_PROXY_SECRET.about: Shared with your first-party proxy, which signs the address it forwards. At least 32 characters. Required for `REAL_IP_HEADER=X-Chokh-Forwarded-For`

GEOIP_DIR.about: Where the geo database is kept

GEOIP_LICENSE_KEY.about: A MaxMind licence key: GeoLite2-City instead of the keyless fallback database

COLLECT_RATE_LIMIT_IP.about: Batches a minute from one address. High, because a campus or an office is one address

COLLECT_RATE_LIMIT_SITE.about: Batches a minute for one site

SESSION_SECRET.about: Signs the dashboard's session cookie. At least 32 characters. Required in production; without it one is made at each start and everybody is signed out

SESSION_TTL_HOURS.about: How long a session lasts, up to 720

SSO_SECRET.about: Shared with the application that mints single sign-on tokens. At least 32 characters. Unset, the exchange refuses everything

SSO_MAX_AGE_SECONDS.about: The longest life a single sign-on token may claim, up to 3600

AUTH_RATE_LIMIT.about: Sign-in and registration attempts a minute per address; the single sign-on exchange, and looking at and using an invitation, each on a count of their own

INVITE_TTL_HOURS.about: How long an invitation can be used, 1 to 720 hours

SHARE_RATE_LIMIT.about: Reads of a public share a minute per address

COOKIE_SECURE.about: `false` lets a developer sign in over plain http
